modification: No modification. Original PRJEB10949 ASV count table processed by Group B.
purpose: Baseline reference for all stress conditions.
expected_effect: Baseline precision, recall, F1, RMSE and Bray-Curtis values.

modification: Set the even mock sample ERR1049996 to zero reads.
purpose: Evaluate how complete loss of one biological replicate affects detection metrics.
expected_effect: Strong loss of detected taxa for that sample; lower even-community metrics compared with ST00.

modification: Downsample all six biological mock samples to 100 reads each.
purpose: Evaluate robustness under extreme low sequencing depth.
expected_effect: Reduced recall/F1, especially for low-abundance taxa in the staggered community.

modification: Force even mock samples to be dominated by a single ASV while preserving total depth.
purpose: Evaluate abundance distortion and loss of community complexity.
expected_effect: Reduced recall and distorted abundance estimates in even samples.

modification: Spike Pseudomonas ASV into H2O blank samples only.
purpose: Evaluate contamination filtering using negative controls.
expected_effect: Should affect contamination summaries/decontam more than validation_metrics.py, because blanks are not part of even/staggered benchmarking.
recommended_evaluation: contamination_filtering.R / decontam module; optionally document that F1 should remain stable

modification: Spike Pseudomonas ASV into even and staggered biological mock samples.
purpose: Evaluate whether artificial contaminant signal increases false positives.
expected_effect: Lower precision and F1 compared with ST00 because the contaminant is not expected in the ground truth.

modification: Insert non-numeric NOT_A_NUMBER values in count cells.
purpose: Check whether downstream scripts fail safely on malformed count tables.
expected_effect: Should fail early with a clear parsing/type error; not used for F1/recall comparison.

modification: Use metadata_wrong.tsv with sample IDs that do not match the ASV table.
purpose: Check whether metadata/sample-ID inconsistencies are detected.
expected_effect: Should be reported as a mismatch; not used for validation_metrics.py because that script does not use metadata.
